from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            if r1>r0 and c1>c0 and len(cells)/area >= 0.75:
                for y in range(r0,r1+1):
                    for x in range(c0,c1+1):
                        out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
(program_dir/'task-4b119b4e.py').write_text(code)
